top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A four year old child did not use a booster seat when being transported to school.

top_violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through 12 years, less than 4 feet 9 inches in height; cannot be properly secured by vehicle belt (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children ages eight through twelve years of age who are  less than 4 feet, 9  inches in height are riding in the operations van/ general purpose vehicle without booster seats.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One of four  of the transportation vehicles did not have a first aid kit available for review.  The other 3 vehicles were missing or had expired supplies from the first aid kits that were added during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director was lacking training in the topic of child maltreatment for the most recent completed training year evaluated.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

top_violation_types.title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §746.2501(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was found during the investigation that one caregiver did not comfort a child in care for several minutes when the child was crying in a classroom.
